summary:
XP Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a cash dividend of US$0.20/share payable June 18, 2026 (record June 10, 2026), aggregating ~R$500M, and a new share repurchase program authorizing up to R$1.0B (USD equivalent) of Class A common shares from May 19, 2026 to May 20, 2027. Purchases may be made under Rule 10b-18/10b5-1 safe harbors via an appointed broker; the program may be modified or discontinued at any time. This is a capital-return event, funded from existing cash, without a fixed commitment for any specific share number.

What to watch: execution pace of buybacks and any expansion/suspension of the program based on market conditions.
